subject: Daz
fact: Daz refused to accept that the fee to get rid of the assassins was covered by the gold received for silence.
source_quote: We didn’t discuss the fee to get rid of the assassins.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz recalled the story of Ezra, who always claimed he couldn’t pay but always could because he needed the First Faction more than they needed him.
source_quote: There was this guy called Ezra, and he kept saying he couldn’t pay and always could. And you know why? Because he needed the First Faction more than they needed him.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noticed the merchant’s offer of gems and the instruction to consult gnomish friends about their value.
source_quote: Here are some gems. Before you sell them, go to your gnomish friends and ask them about their value.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz understood that the topic had been exhausted and that pressing further would be futile.
source_quote: Daz is tempted to press the topic, but even he knows when a rock is bled dry.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz explained the agreements made and the necessity of entering the Whorlstone Tunnels to find evidence for at least one faction.
source_quote: He explains the deals they have made, and that to get out of Gracklstugh, they will have to go into the Whorlstone Tunnels and find the evidence for at least one of the many different factions.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar identified the gems as empty spell gems and named the alchemist in Blingdenstone who could restore them.
source_quote: Now that is something I didn’t expect. These are empty spell gems. There is an alchemist in Blingdenstone who can turn these gems into gems of immense magical power. If you bring these to Kazook Pickshine, he will pay a lot for them.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir learned that Myconids do not dance and that something was wrong with them.
source_quote: Myconids don’t dance. We should find out what’s wrong with them.

subject: Stool
fact: Stool recognized Rumpadump as his friend and insisted they must save him because he could reveal what was happening.
source_quote: That’s my friend Rumpadump. Something’s wrong. We must go save him!

subject: Stool's obligation to save Rumpadump
fact: Stool believes Rumpadump must be saved because he is from his circle and can reveal what is happening, but the timing and feasibility of this mission remain unresolved.
source_quote: Because he’s from my circle. And the dancing Myconids must be from our circle. And he can tell us what is going on! We have to save him!

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir dismissed the concern over the sprout as less urgent than the Myconids.
source_quote: The sprout is not as concerning as the myconids.

subject: Stool
fact: Stool believes Quagoths are savage monsters because they attacked, and the Myconids had to kill them.
source_quote: Quagotths are bad, mean creatures. The quagoth attacked, and those Myconids had to kill him.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin noted the biological determinism in Stool’s reasoning about the Quagoths and Myconids.
source_quote: A bit of biological determinism there?

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir acknowledged that they were already overwhelmed by obligations and doubted they could save Rumpadump.
source_quote: We are already knee deep in so many obligations that I am not sure we can do that, my friend.

subject: Stool
fact: Stool began sobbing, or what Zalthir thought was sobbing, in response to Zalthir’s reluctance.
source_quote: The sprout starts to sob, or what Zalthir thinks is sobbing.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir realized they would have to act on Stool’s request despite their burdens.
source_quote: Zalthir groans as he realizes that they will have to do more thing.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir agreed to postpone saving Rumpadump until after dealing with the assassins.
source_quote: We can do it after we deal with the assassins?

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir believed that sewing the tattoos onto his body might prevent his death.
source_quote: He thinks that perhaps now he won’t die.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz observed that Thargus Ironhead was lying and trying to survive.
source_quote: He’s lying and trying to survive.

subject: Grinta Ironhead
fact: Grinta Ironhead offered a discounted trade deal with the gnomes if the Deepking were deposed.
source_quote: Be advised that the Deepking has imposed exorbitant pricing upon the Deep Gnomes. It is my proposition that were the Deepking to be deposed, Clan Ironhead would be afforded the liberty to conduct trade with the gnomes, and we would willingly extend a discounted rate relative to our standard tariffs.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz recognized that every faction knew they were entering the Whorlstone Tunnels and hoped the information would benefit them.
source_quote: They all know that we are going into the Whorlstone tunnels, and they all hope the information we provide will help them.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum reminded the group of the need to free Thermbachaude.
source_quote: And free Thermbachaude.

subject: 1st day of the 2nd Tenday of Myrtul 1493
fact: The events of this day occurred, including the arrival at Underlake Hold, the audience with Thargus Ironhead, and the encounter with Grinta Ironhead.
source_quote: The following day, Jimjar, Spiderbait, Sarith, and Eldeth walk to the Underlake Hold, where Errde arms them.
